Connect
Eufy scale: in the EufyLife app, turn on Health Connect (or Google Fit) for weight. Forza! then gets every weigh-in automatically.

Forza! Health reads only: daily step count, body weight, body fat percentage, exercise sessions (such as walks) and meals (name, meal and nutrients, as logged in food apps) from Health Connect.

The data is sent over an encrypted connection to the Forza! server set up by your family administrator, where it is visible only to you and to that administrator. It is used only to show your progress in the Forza! app. Nothing is sold or shared.

Only if you turn it on in Accessibility: when you start a workout sync, Forza! Health reads your workout history in the Build With Science app (names, dates, sets, weights and effort) and sends it to the same server. It reads no other app.

You can remove access at any time in Health Connect settings, or uninstall this app.
Build With Science workouts

Forza! Health can bring over your Build With Science workouts on this phone, without a computer: it opens Build With Science and reads your workout history like you would, while you leave the phone unlocked for a couple of minutes. To allow it, turn on Forza! Health in Accessibility (once).
If the switch is greyed out: tap \"App info\", then the ⋮ menu (top right) → \"Allow restricted settings\", and try again.

Forza! Health: Build With Science workouts

Forza! Health reads your workout history in the Build With Science app, only when you start a sync, so it can show your workouts in Forza! without a computer. It opens Build With Science, taps rows to open them, reads the sets and scrolls, then goes back to the home screen. It never changes anything in Build With Science and reads no other app.
